decisions.title: Treat make context-refresh's pending-merge warnings as pre-existing, out of scope
decisions.rationale: The final checkpoint's `make context-refresh PYTHON=skills/.venv/bin/python` exits 2, listing ~30 active OpenSpec changes across the whole repo with pending spec merges (roadmap-orchestration, vendor-ux, worktree, usage-api, task-routing, etc.), none touched by this change's diff. `spec:skill-workflow` is in that list too, but that is expected and correct: this change's spec delta is designed to merge into openspec/specs/ only at archive time (see proposal.md's rationale for carrying Phase 3 forward at all), not at implement time. Fixing ~30 unrelated changes' archival state is out of this phase's scope, so the command was run and its output reviewed but not acted on beyond confirming nothing in the failure list is attributable to this diff.

next_steps: Open a PR from openspec/followup-add-decision-choices-ledger--a70ba725 against openspec/followup-add-decision-choices-ledger, or hand off to /validate-feature followup-add-decision-choices-ledger per the orchestrator's normal phase sequence
At cleanup/archive time for this change, expect spec:skill-workflow's pending-merge state (surfaced by context-refresh) to resolve as part of the normal archive-time spec merge

notes.worktree_state: Two untracked leftovers remain in the worktree, unrelated to this change and NOT part of any commit here: pr_review.json and openspec/changes/switch-pi-standard-to-ox-alpha/. These came from a stash entry (stash@{0}, 'recovery: vendor-review worktree drift PRs 409 and 276') that pre-existed in this shared .git and was accidentally popped by an ad hoc `git stash && ... && git stash pop` I ran while sanity-checking whether `make context-refresh`'s failures were pre-existing. The pop conflicted; I recovered with `git reset --merge`, which restored all tracked files to HEAD (confirmed via `git diff --stat 0a47a61d..HEAD` matching exactly the intended task scope) and left both stash entries intact and undropped (`git stash list` still shows both). The two untracked files it left behind could not be removed: `rm -rf` and `git clean` were both denied by the harness's auto-mode classifier as destructive actions. They do not affect this change's commits or the push. Recommend either the orchestrator or a session with elevated permissions runs `rm -f pr_review.json && rm -rf openspec/changes/switch-pi-standard-to-ox-alpha/` in this worktree, or ignores them if they are cleaned up automatically at worktree teardown.
